name: apxium
description: Read-only Apxium (Practice Engine) practice-management data via the myHub-hosted Apxium MCP gateway — clients and matters/jobs for accounting and legal firms.

connection.instructions:
Apxium (Practice Engine) uses machine-to-machine OAuth2 client-credentials — there is no login redirect, and you never paste a bearer token; the gateway exchanges your App Id/App Key for a short-lived token automatically on every call.

1. In your Practice Engine instance, sign in as a PE Admin and go to **Admin → API Authentication Administration** (or browse directly to `https://<your-practice>.pehosted.com/PE/Admin/APIAuth`).
2. Create a new API credential. PE issues an **AppId** and an **AppKey** — these are your OAuth2 `client_id`/`client_secret`, mapped to a staff user account.
3. Make sure the staff user the AppId maps to has these PE permissions: `API_Admin`, `API_Banking`, `API_Billing`, `API_Client`, `API_Export`, `ClientDRS`, `ClientSearch`, `LodgeHeader`. Without them, calls will be rejected even with a valid AppId/AppKey.
4. Copy the **AppId** and **AppKey** below, and enter your practice's **Site** — the subdomain before `.pehosted.com` (e.g. `acme` for `acme.pehosted.com`).
